title: Malicious code in dowload_ebok_the_duke_s_secret_heir_by_sarah_mallory_w476t (npm)
description: The npm package 'dowload_ebok_the_duke_s_secret_heir_by_sarah_mallory_w476t' contains malicious code that compromises any computer on which it is installed or run. Installation of this package may result in full system compromise, including unauthorized access to secrets and keys stored on the affected machine. Immediate removal of the package is advised, but full remediation may require rotating all secrets from a separate, uncompromised system due to potential persistent malicious presence.
